description:
Get the creator record of a verified coin: how many coins its creator launched before (launchesTotal, launchesAlive, launchesDead7d), what their wallets hold now and held at launch, events such as creator_sold and creator_exited with dates, bundled at open, paid promoters, and every label with its one-line definition. Read from the chains by Chain Daddy.

Params: chain (chain key, e.g. base, solana), symbol (ticker)
Returns: the record as JSON. state is first_launch, on_record, serial, blocked or pending.
Errors: NOT_AVAILABLE (no verified page for that ticker on that chain, or the record is not available yet), API_ERROR
name: get_creator_record
title: Get a coin's creator record
